name: Tim Dooley / Potato of Life Atlas — Canonical Work Order
purpose: Machine-readable master workflow. Every future enrichment pass starts with repository audit and ends with validation. The Atlas is one navigable system whose internal datasets remain modular but whose identities, relationships, evidence and routes are canonicalized.

project_introduction.mission: Build a living, searchable and evidence-aware atlas of Tim Dooley, the Potato of Life, Potatoism, people, dwellers, dogs, cultures, religions, texts, places, nations, institutions, organizations, technologies, infrastructures, economies, conflicts and ideas. The primary object is not the isolated record but the relationship between records and the way those relationships change through space and time.
project_introduction.separation_rule: The four fields may connect through explicit relationships, but they must not be silently collapsed. Observable evidence, historical interpretation, project theory and mythic canon retain distinct epistemic classes.
project_introduction.depth_rule: A label is not an entry; a metadata record is not a corpus; a country count is not country research; a relationship is incomplete until its endpoints, type, status and provenance can be resolved.
project_introduction.entanglement_principle: Relationships may have distance, direction, strength, dependency, coupling, feedback, temporal order, path dependence, topology, trajectory and phase. Network coupling is not automatically quantum entanglement, and symbolic destiny is not empirical causation.
project_introduction.goal: Make the Atlas navigable from multiple directions so that every important entity has a canonical home, meaningful children, reciprocal relationships, evidence trails and an explicit statement of what is known, unknown or interpreted.
project_introduction.method: Audit first; repair second; canonicalize third; validate fourth; source and populate fifth; connect sixth; model seventh; expose eighth; audit again. Preserve uncertainty throughout.

core_rule: Do not expand a broken, duplicated or orphaned layer. Critical integrity failures outrank enrichment.

gates.name: Snapshot
gates.rule: Record the starting commit before substantial mutation.

gates.name: Bug gate
gates.rule: Broken JSON, scripts, routes, references and CI failures outrank new data.

gates.name: Ownership gate
gates.rule: Every substantive dataset has one canonical owner and an explicit consumer.

gates.name: Identity gate
gates.rule: Canonical IDs are stable; aliases resolve to them; duplicate identities are reported.

gates.name: Evidence gate
gates.rule: Empirical and historical claims carry provenance; project symbolism carries an epistemic label.

gates.name: Graph gate
gates.rule: Relationship endpoints resolve through canonical nodes, country indexes or explicit bridges.

gates.name: Depth gate
gates.rule: Important visible records must contain substance and useful relationships, not merely labels.

gates.name: View gate
gates.rule: Website pages consume canonical data and do not become competing data stores.

gates.name: Release gate
gates.rule: Counts and manifests are updated only after underlying data and checks pass.

gates.name: Epistemic gate
gates.rule: Never infer causality, quantum entanglement, destiny or spiritual mechanism from correlation alone.

phases.name: Full repository audit
tasks: classify every dataset by owner and role
find duplicate IDs and exact duplicate files
audit CI workflows and latest runs
record bugs, orphans, stale claims and unused files

phases.name: Repair broken paths
tasks: rerun CI after each structural repair

phases.name: Build religion, belief and text layers
tasks: full public-domain primary texts where lawful

phases.name: Build people, organizations and security graph
tasks: separate legal designation from media terminology

phases.name: Build North Programme / European Economic Graph
tasks: North as network rather than membership list

phases.name: Build Potatoism and Tim Dooley canon
tasks: February 2026 external event plus separate project interpretation
clear distinction between canon and evidence

phases.name: Build emotion and psychological state layer
Expose the canonical system
tasks: filters by entity type and epistemic class

phases.name: Final release audit
tasks: only declare milestone complete after critical checks pass

audit_state.last_known_ci_failure: Architecture validator reported four unsynchronized backend endpoints on commit 8ce6d1cdb64154fafda4eeef632dca963847e9d0 and then reported a workflow phase-name mismatch after the workflow was expanded.
audit_state.next_action: rerun CI and continue Phase 1 audit; do not declare the repository clean until all workflows pass and the full audit report exists.

expansion_rule: Before creating a new file, determine whether an existing canonical owner can hold the information. If yes, extend it. If a new file is necessary, register its owner, schema, consumer and manifest location immediately.
definition_of_done: A phase is complete only when its data exists, canonical ownership is explicit, IDs and relationships resolve, provenance is adequate, missing data is explicit, duplicates are controlled, frontend consumers work, manifests are accurate and critical integrity checks pass.
